scope: Targeted primary-source methods review, not systematic literature search. Fresh reading depths explicit; retrieval alone not deep reading.

sources.title: YouNiverse: Large-Scale Channel and Video Metadata from English-Speaking YouTube
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official 9-page PDF; selected collection/filtering/bias and distribution passages read
sources.reading_locators: pp.1016–1019: Dataset Collection and Preprocessing, Figure1; channelcrawler thresholds, langdetect gate; Figure6 bias/weighting discussion
sources.supported_use: Third-party channel frame plus platform metadata; explicit thresholds, language filtering, missingness and source-specific sampling weights.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Not random YouTube census; >10k subscribers/>10videos and English restrictions. Its weights cannot be transferred to this curated sample.

sources.title: {Tube2Vec}: Social and Semantic Embeddings of {YouTube} Channels
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official 7-page PDF; introduction, data, embedding methods and evaluation passages read
sources.supported_use: 50 recent video titles/descriptions, MiniLM384-dimensional vectors averaged by account; social and recommendation representations evaluated against tasks including human triplet judgments.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: 44k filtered English channels above100k subscribers; topic resemblance differs from social positions. Account centroids are established, not novel here. No reproduced human validation.

sources.title: The Digital Landscape of God: Narrative, Visuals and Viewer Engagement of Religious Videos on {YouTube}
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official 18-page PDF; Data&Methods, selected figure/table structure and limitations read
sources.reading_locators: pp.471–472 Data&Methods and p.478 Limitations; narrative/visual/comment branches
sources.supported_use: Keyword/API-v3 discovery; human-developed codebook and review of model outputs; local Qwen narrative coding and LoRA comment classifier with separate human-held-out sample.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Five religion names, view-count-ranked selection and genre exclusions shape sample. Authors report human coding; our model-panel reviews cannot inherit their reliability or representativeness. First10minutes/480p is study-specific visual protocol.

sources.title: Pathways to Conspiracy Theorizing on YouTube in Japan
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official 7-page PDF; classification and transition-network methods plus selected figures read
sources.reading_locators: pp.2636–2638; 100-video manual check, 5-point classifier, five chronological upload segments; comment-sequence network
sources.supported_use: State operational labels, manual evaluation and chronology bins; make proxy behavior explicit.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Comment transitions are not observed watch history; neither their labels nor claims about political/spiritual creators transfer to this corpus. No causal inference borrowed.

sources.title: Channelers' Answers to Questions from Scientists: An Exploratory Study
sources.publication_class: Journal of Scientific Exploration 2023 research article; peer-reviewed venue
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official 22-page PDF; abstract, question/session methods, correspondence criteria and discussion passages read
sources.reading_locators: pp.348,351–356,365–366; Table1 questions and correspondence/qualitative distinction
sources.supported_use: Elicited matched-question study distinguishes low quantitative correspondence from recurring qualitative themes. Different response relations are different constructs.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Quantitative comparison uses7US participants while qualitative corpus covers15across2sites; Q4 differed across sites and conditions had timing/order limitations. No source-origin validation.

sources.title: Semantic Correspondence Between Trance-Channeled {ET} Messages and Ufological Records
sources.publication_class: Journal of Scientific Exploration 2026 research article; peer-reviewed venue
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official 14-page PDF; methods/results and selected public supplementary prompt pages read
sources.reading_locators: pp.185–187 processing/query/embedding methods; supplement29912237/file57193115 contents and prompt p.3
sources.supported_use: Separate archives are queried using shared10questions, then generated answers are embedded by3encoders. Distinguish source discourse from AI-mediated archival answers.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Same-generator/shared positive framing may confound similarity. Default tokenization without explicit chunking does not establish full-document coverage. Reported274submitted−224excluded≠52included is an unresolved source arithmetic inconsistency. No independent reproduction.

sources.title: A qualitative exploratory analysis of channeled content
sources.publication_class: EXPLORE 2020 journal article; institutional abstract rechecked
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh institutional abstract only; earlier coauthor manuscript access remains prior-release evidence
sources.reading_locators: IONS publication abstract:13adult channels, recorded over2days, final experimental prompt and7themes
sources.supported_use: Prompt-conditioned qualitative thematic analysis is an empirical precedent for contextual coding.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: This phase did not reacquire the full manuscript. Themes elicited under one prompt do not quantify naturalistic video-topic prevalence.

sources.title: Semantic Structure and Correspondence in Prospective Trance-Channeled Communications Attributed to Extraterrestrial Intelligences
sources.publication_class: World Futures 2026 journal article; publisher fulltext denied
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh institutional abstract plus public Figshare supplement code inspected; publisher HTTP403
sources.reading_locators: IONS abstract; Figshare31100860 code61152403 lines94–150 and241–273
sources.supported_use: Three-channeler/28domain structured program; public code shows per-question concatenation and direct encode, and global concatenation then encode. Test input-length sensitivity.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Publisher fullmethods unavailable. Code inspected, not executed; no participant answers or exact inference reproduced. Lack of explicit chunking in this public file is not proof of unreported study procedures.

sources.title: Qualitative Structure and Meaning in Prospective Trance-Channeled Communications Attributed to Extraterrestrial Intelligences
sources.publication_class: World Futures 2026 journal article; publisher fulltext denied
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh institutional abstract only; publisher HTTP403
sources.reading_locators: IONS abstract: reflexive thematic analysis of prospective interviews
sources.supported_use: Organized meaning-making is distinct from an origin claim; narrative themes and semantic similarities answer different questions.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: No fresh publisher fulltext or independent thematic coding. Same program as semantic paper; not independent replication.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
sources.fresh_access_depth: Official proceedings metadata and public author PDF; abstract/introduction and model formulation read
sources.reading_locators: Sections1–2, parametric seq2seq model plus nonparametric dense index; RAG-Sequence/RAG-Token
sources.supported_use: Retrieval-augmented generation contains both retriever and generative model.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Retrieval-only ranking, nearest-neighbor answer copying and extractive lookup are not automatically RAG or factual verification. Their model/training/evaluation not reproduced here.

sources.title: REALM: Retrieval-Augmented Language Model Pre-Training
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official PMLR10-page PDF; abstract/model-training overview read
sources.reading_locators: Abstract and Sections1–2: latent neural knowledge retriever, masked-language pretraining
sources.supported_use: Retrieval can be part of training as well as inference; label actual model adaptation precisely.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: REALM pretraining is not the same as adding TF-IDF retrieval to an unchanged generator or fitting a LoRA adapter.

sources.title: Fine-Tuning or Retrieval? Comparing Knowledge Injection in LLMs
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official14-page PDF after single503retry; abstract, distinctions and experimental-design passages read
sources.reading_locators: pp.237–242, Sections2–4: factual MCQ definition, supervised vs unsupervised FT, compared unsupervised FT and RAG
sources.supported_use: Specify which fine-tuning objective is executed and compare under actual knowledge/task conditions.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Reported RAG advantage is from their tasks against unsupervised FT; it does not establish universal superiority over supervised LoRA or this channeling corpus. MCQ accuracy is not answer attribution or claim truth.

sources.title: Does Fine-Tuning LLMs on New Knowledge Encourage Hallucinations?
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official20-page PDF; abstract, SliCK/experimental setup and training-duration results read
sources.reading_locators: pp.7765–7769, Sections3–4; known/unknown QA stratification and development early stopping
sources.supported_use: Separate adaptation behavior from factual knowledge acquisition; retain base-model controls and held-out/development distinctions.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Controlled closed-book QA study; no universal theorem that all fine-tuning hallucinates. Training on digest assertions does not turn their content into factual ground truth.

sources.title: ARES: An Automated Evaluation Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official17-page PDF; abstract, evaluation inputs, judge/PPI methods and selected experiment passages read
sources.reading_locators: pp.338–342, Section3: passage set,approx150human validation data,5few-shot examples,synthetic judges,PPI
sources.supported_use: Assess context relevance, answer faithfulness and answer relevance separately; calibration requires independent labeled data.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Human-calibrated prediction-powered intervals are not available merely because an LLM judges its own outputs. Relevance/faithfulness do not establish external truth.

sources.title: RAGAs: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official9-page PDF; abstract and metric construction read
sources.reading_locators: pp.150–153, faithfulness statement extraction, answer relevance,context relevance
sources.supported_use: Separate evaluation dimensions and disclose model-assisted metric construction.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Reference-free scores are automated proxies; they are not human-validated answer agreement or evidence that source claims are true. Paper version uses specific hosted models, not our local model.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official17-page PDF; abstract, controlled multi-document setup and position/length findings read
sources.reading_locators: pp.157–160, Sections1–2; fixed answer-bearing paragraph plus distractors and position permutations
sources.supported_use: Audit retrieved-token limits and evidence position, not only maximum advertised context length.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Effects are model/task specific. Does not demonstrate the same numerical degradation for current local checkpoints or caption chunks.

sources.title: Deduplicating Training Data Makes Language Models Better
sources.fresh_access_depth: Fresh official22-page PDF; abstract,introduction and exact/approximate duplicate definitions read
sources.reading_locators: pp.8424–8427; train–validation overlap and substring/full-document matching
sources.supported_use: Audit duplicate/near-duplicate source families across training,development,test and retrieval evaluation.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: Large-scale LM training findings motivate controls; title or question dedup is not proof of independent original sessions. No dataset dedup error rate inherited.

sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
sources.publication_class: ICLR 2022 per author repository citation; authorpreprint v2 read
sources.fresh_access_depth: Public author arXiv2106.09685v2 PDF; abstract,parameterization and author repo citation inspected; OpenReviewPDF403
sources.reading_locators: Author manuscript pp.1–4, Figure1; microsoft/LoRA README citation lines167–175
sources.supported_use: Freeze base weights and train low-rank adaptation matrices; report rank,targetmodules,trainable parameter count and actual weight update.
sources.limits_and_nontransfer: A logistic classifier,retriever refit or changed prompt is not LoRA. Author manuscript access differs from publisher final fulltext; no domain performance inherited.
